name: ufe3d-mcp
description: Build and debug UFE features with your coding agent using official reference context, source links, and freshness warnings.

interface.longDescription: Give your coding agent official UFE reference context while it builds, debugs, and plans features. The MCP searches and reads the manual with source links and freshness warnings; your agent's own project tools implement and verify requested changes. No model API key is required by the connector.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use UFE3D-MCP to gather the UFE context needed for my task. Inspect relevant project files if available, retrieve and cite the official documentation, and implement and verify changes only within my requested scope.
